web-client.rationale: Cosmos sessions are accessed through the web app; the docs also name phone and Slack access without establishing native mobile clients. Scope: Auggie CLI, Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent, Augment IDE extensions.

cli.rationale: Auggie is the terminal client with Augment's agent and Context Engine. Scope: Auggie CLI, Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent, Augment IDE extensions.

own-server.rationale: The vendor advertises own machines or mixed pools alongside managed cloud sandboxes; provisioning details were not established. Scope: Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Cosmos runs agents in cloud VMs; an Environment defines base image, repositories and environment variables. Scope: Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent.

local.rationale: Auggie runs next to local code; macOS/Linux/Windows WSL prerequisites are documented.

vm.rationale: Cloud work uses sandboxed VMs; security isolation was not tested. Scope: Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent.

worktree.rationale: Isolated daemon sessions use separate Git worktrees per repository.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Cron is a documented Cosmos trigger source. Scope: Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent.

sso.rationale: Enterprise lists SSO, OIDC and SCIM. Scope: Auggie CLI, Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent, Augment IDE extensions.

starting-price.rationale: Standard costs $20/month and Business $100/month for up to fifty seats, with equal included dollar usage, checked 7 November 2026. Included seats and usage are pooled across the team rather than priced per seat on Standard/Business. Further scoped facts are recorded in the atomic answers. Scope: Auggie CLI, Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent, Augment IDE extensions.

ios.rationale: Cosmos explicitly has no separate iOS application.

android.rationale: Cosmos explicitly has no separate Android application.

mobile-web.rationale: Sessions explicitly work in a phone browser.

parallel-runs.rationale: Auggie subagents explicitly run in parallel.

coordinator.rationale: Project Builder dispatches PR Author workers and reports their outcomes.

issue-tracking.rationale: IDE Tasklist retains product-owned editable tasks with not-started, active and completed states and can move into a new chat.

review.note: The IDE Tasklist is a per-conversation plan with task states; the cited page shows it can move to a new chat but does not establish persistence across restarts or a product-owned task store outside the chat (PLAN-02 restart_persistence stays unknown). That does not meet the persistent issue/task threshold.

roles.rationale: Administrator and Member have documented permission differences.

pr-workflow.rationale: PR Author creates and maintains PRs/MRs.

review-ui.rationale: IDE Changes view displays the diff for a completed Tasklist task.

per-seat.rationale: Up to 50 seats included without per-seat charges.

usage-based.rationale: Pay-as-you-go top-ups; LLM at list rates plus 40% fee.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete current public plan list consists of paid Standard/Business and custom Enterprise with pooled usage and top-ups. It omits a no-paid-plan ADE plan; trial access is separate.

free-plan.rationale: The complete current public plan list consists of paid Standard/Business and custom Enterprise with pooled usage and top-ups. It omits a free-plan ADE plan; trial access is separate.

byok.rationale: The complete current public plan list consists of paid Standard/Business and custom Enterprise with pooled usage and top-ups. It omits a byok ADE plan; trial access is separate.

one-time.rationale: The complete current public plan list consists of paid Standard/Business and custom Enterprise with pooled usage and top-ups. It omits a one-time ADE plan; trial access is separate.

paid-from.rationale: Standard $20/month. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

laptop-independent.rationale: Cosmos runs coding sessions in managed cloud VMs, independently of the browser/laptop client. The separate local Auggie CLI still depends on its execution host.

license.rationale: The main platform uses vendor-authored professional/enterprise terms with limited access and retained company IP. This receipt does not infer an SDK or component license for the whole ADE.

free-tier.rationale: The complete public pricing cards list paid plans and separate trial use; a trial does not meet recurring free access.
